change_ticket_id: PR-4082 (Palo Alto Security Rule + IAM Attachment)
executive_summary: Proposed Palo Alto rule disables App-ID deep inspection by setting application to 'any' and destination to 'any', creating an uninspected egress tunnel while IAM changes grant access to the Restricted CUI Vault.
predicted_affected_assets: Trust-DMZ Zone (Direct: Egress opened to destination 'any' without Security Profile group)
Untrust-Internet Zone (Direct: Arbitrary non-SSL outbound tunneling permitted)
eks-analytics-worker-pool (Direct: Pods gain uninspected egress capabilities)

identified_security_gaps.gap_title: Palo Alto App-ID & Threat Inspection Bypass
identified_security_gaps.technical_impact: Setting 'applications = any' and 'security_profile_group = none' turns off Palo Alto's Layer 7 inspection, allowing malicious actors to tunnel C2 traffic over port 443 without malware scanning.
identified_security_gaps.compliance_violation: CIS Palo Alto Firewall Benchmark v1.1.0 (Rule 4.1 - Enforce App-ID) & NIST CSF 2.0 PR.PT-04

identified_security_gaps.gap_title: Wildcard IAM CUI Data Exfiltration Path
identified_security_gaps.technical_impact: Attaching AmazonS3FullAccess allows compromised analytics pods to bypass zone boundaries and exfiltrate proprietary CUI data directly to unmonitored endpoints.
identified_security_gaps.compliance_violation: NIST SP 800-171 3.1.3 (Control CUI Flow) & Least Privilege PR.AA-05

identified_security_gaps.technical_impact: Bypasses zero-trust egress filtering. Outbound connections are no longer scoped to verified external logging partners.

pre_implementation_validation_plan.what_to_validate: Verify that the rule enforces explicit App-ID ('ssl') and rejects uninspected protocols.
pre_implementation_validation_plan.cli_command: test security-policy-match from Trust-DMZ to Untrust-Internet source 10.100.4.50 destination 52.84.120.5 protocol 6 port 443 application ssl
pre_implementation_validation_plan.expected_pass_criteria: Rule matched MUST show application 'ssl' and action 'allow'. Matching on application 'any' is an immediate fail.

pre_implementation_validation_plan.what_to_validate: Confirm that the Security Profile Group is attached and active before committing.
Verify that analytics execution role is restricted strictly to telemetry staging.

safe_remediated_config:
# SIMUGUARD AUTO-REMEDIATED PALO ALTO TERRAFORM PATCH
resource "panos_security_policy" "analytics_egress_rule_safe" {
  rule {
    name                  = "Allow-Analytics-Outbound-Webhook-Safe"
    source_zones          = ["Trust-DMZ"]
    source_addresses      = ["10.100.4.0/24"]
    destination_zones     = ["Untrust-Internet"]
    destination_addresses = ["52.84.120.0/22"] # Scoped to verified partner
    applications          = ["ssl", "web-browsing"] # Layer-7 App-ID enforced
    services              = ["service-https"]
    action                = "allow"
    security_profile_group = "Strict-Enterprise-Security" # Antivirus, Anti-Spyware active
  }
}
